reference itself is cross-backend inconsistent on this variant (fresh 2026-10-04 measurement at authority noisemaker@296e0138: reference webgl2-vs-webgpu goldens max 119, SSIM 0.621165, the same divergence the port was measured at vs the webgl2 golden): the reference GLSL (glsl/shape.glsl randomFromLatticeWithOffset — lattice-int pcg3d + XOR jitter, separate (40,0) time lattice) and WGSL (wgsl/shape.wgsl constant() — prng over floor(st*freq)+seed, one lattice for time and value) implement different lattice hashes; the Unity Metal candidate byte-matches the reference WebGPU golden (max 0-1, SSIM 1.0) and its candidate SHA equals the pass-31 wgsl_candidate_sha256; upstream reference inconsistency, no faithful WebGL2 golden for the WGSL-canonical behavior
